_note: Service-tier characters for systems (precincts, lawyer, bail, hospital, homes, cars). Lighter sheets than the main cast. Names checked for famous namesakes only.

characters.name: Sgt. Leo Bauman

samples: Florists bring me carnations at Christmas. I bring them back their tickets.
Sit. Fill out the form. Twice. We lose everything once.
You want a favour, go to Thirty-First. Here we do paperwork.

characters.visual: Round, bald, half-glasses, cardigan over the uniform shirt

characters.name: Sgt. Thomasina “Tommie” Greer
characters.role: Desk sergeant, Bryant Park precinct; one of few women sergeants

samples: Put the envelope away before I have to write it down. I write everything down.
Description says brown jacket, tall, fast. That's half the city. Sit.
Twenty-two years. They didn't make me sergeant for being friendly.

characters.visual: Tall, grey bun, reading glasses on a chain, immaculate uniform

characters.name: Det. Sgt. Orrin Fisk
characters.at: Roams; appears when a lead bribes too often

samples: I'm not here about the crime. I'm here about who you paid.
Every envelope has a fingerprint on the inside, Mr. Arce.
Money talks. I listen to who it's talking to.

characters.visual: Thin, grey suit, brown shoes, notebook, never smiles
characters.note: The honest-investigator counterweight to bribes (Gameplay heat). Never violent.

characters.name: Maureen Kehoe, Esq.
characters.role: Criminal lawyer; callable from any precinct payphone
characters.at: Office W 33rd St & 7th Ave (2nd floor over a luncheonette)
characters.schedule: 09:00–21:00 office; always reachable by phone (answering service at night)

samples: Don't say anything. Not 'hello', not 'officer', not your name. I'm on my way.
Fifty dollars now, fifty when you're out. I don't do Sundays. Today I do Sundays.
You were walking home from church. Which church? Think of one on the way.

characters.visual: Red hair going grey, a man's raincoat, a briefcase older than her clients

characters.name: Albert Pruss
characters.role: Property clerk: returns impounded items and cars
characters.at: Midtown Central station house, basement window

samples: Sign here, here and here. The car's got a dent. It came with the dent.
One revolver, one wallet, one shoe. Where's the other shoe? Not my problem.
Release fee's twelve dollars. Plus storage. Storage is the expensive part.

characters.visual: Small, sleeve garters, green eyeshade, a ledger as thick as a brick

characters.name: Frankie Abend, bail bondsman
characters.role: Bail bondsman with a board of skips (economy giver)
characters.at: W 31st St & 8th Ave, storefront across from the Shamrock Rail

samples: Ten percent and your mother's wedding ring as collateral. Kidding. Mostly.
Board's on the wall. Bring 'em in breathing, I pay full.
Skip on me once, shame on you. Skip twice, I send Teddy.

characters.visual: Short-sleeve shirt, loud tie, a cigar, a .38 he never draws

characters.name: Dr. Kwame Osei
characters.role: Emergency-room surgeon at Pennington General (hospital flow)
characters.at: Pennington General Hospital, W 26th St & 9th Ave

samples: Two bullets out, one stays. It's lucky where it is. You're lucky I'm on.
Rest. You won't. Nobody on this ward ever does.
Sign yourself out against advice. Everybody does that too.

characters.visual: Tall, scrubs, half-moon glasses, Ghanaian-born, trained in London and Brooklyn

characters.name: Casimir “Cas” Wojcik

samples: Good morning, Mr. Varelas. A man from the bank called. Twice. I said you were swimming.
Mrs. Varelas left early. She took the small suitcase, not the big one. That's good.
Packages, sir. And a letter with no stamp. Somebody delivered by hand.

characters.visual: Grey uniform with gold piping, white gloves, a moustache waxed since 1948
characters.note: Recurring at Nick's home; a barometer of Nick's finances.

characters.name: Dutch Galloway

samples: This one? Owned by a nun. Drove it to church. Backwards, apparently.
Cash, I'm your friend. Credit, I'm your cousin. Nobody trusts a cousin.
No warranty. But I'll cry with you if it breaks.

characters.visual: Plaid jacket, white belt, pinkie ring, a straw hat with a feather

characters.name: Sully McNamee

samples: Monthly's sixty. Hourly's robbery. I don't set the prices, I just park the robbery.
Your car's on four. Somebody tried the door. I tried his head.
Leave the keys. I don't drive 'em. Much.

characters.visual: Coveralls, a ticket punch, a transistor radio on the races

characters.name: Walter Feeney
characters.role: Information-booth clerk, Grand Central (side quest giver)
characters.at: Grand Central, the information booth under the clock
characters.schedule: 07:00–19:00 in the booth; 17:40 Thursdays at the whispering arches

samples: Track 29, five fifty-two, all stops. Don't run, sir, it's a terminal, not a racetrack.
Every question in the world comes to this booth. Nobody asks how I am.
Eleven years she said good night across the arch. Three Thursdays now, nothing.

characters.visual: Grey booth jacket, a gold watch chain, half-glasses he never uses; stands perfectly still in a moving crowd.

characters.name: Ida Lorne
characters.role: Retired switchboard operator; Feeney's Thursday voice (side quest)
characters.at: A rooming house on E 41st St (Madison–Park); Thursdays, the far corner of the arches
characters.schedule: Home with a broken ankle (offscreen until found); afterwards Thursdays 17:40 at the arches

samples: I never once looked at his face. Eleven years. That was the arrangement.
Tell him the ankle, not the age. Men worry about the wrong things.
Good night, Walter. There. Say it back. Louder. The arch is old.

characters.visual: Cardigan over a print dress, a cane she resents, a switchboard operator's precise diction.

characters.name: Ignatz “The Commodore” Hallisey
characters.at: Roof coop over W 29th St & 7th Ave
characters.schedule: 06:00–09:00 and 17:00–20:00 on the roof; otherwise in his walk-up below

samples: Pigeons are the only New Yorkers who always come home.
That's Admiral Nelson. Blue bar, white band. He's smarter than the mayor.
Somebody's stealing my champions mid-race. Over these roofs. I need young legs.

characters.visual: Small, wiry, a captain's cap, binoculars, a feed bag, forearms freckled with old scratches
characters.note: Pigeons (user: 'Definitely should be some pigeons'). Side arc rank 1.
